reason: A web client plugin for managing reusable words and phrases in global or project-scoped browser storage and inserting selected entries into the conversation input.

summaries.zh: 在对话输入框旁提供常用词面板，用于保存、管理并快速插入全局或当前项目的词语和短句。
summaries.en: Adds a common-words panel beside the conversation input for saving, managing, and quickly inserting global or project-specific words and phrases.

capabilities: Stores reusable words and phrases in browser localStorage
Separates entries globally and by current workspace
Adds a user interface panel to the conversation input area
Appends selected entries to the conversation draft
